media:group.media:title: The First Test.​
media:group.media:description:
The next BMW ALPINA series production vehicle has completed its first speed test at Nardò test track, successfully reaching the 300 km/h benchmark. ​​
Every detail is engineered with one purpose: to achieve the distinctive balance of composition, capability and performance that defines BMW ALPINA. ​​
From the precisely calibrated chassis to the powertrain, countless refinements come together to create a driving experience that feels surprisingly sublime at any pace. ​​
Made to turn great distances into elevated journeys.
